kicker: Audio8, read through its own configs

scenes.headline: How Audio8's recognizers hear, and ship
scenes.sub: Eight open audio checkpoints, one shared encoder, and a ladder of deployment builds.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bitsy! Audio8 open-sourced eight audio checkpoints in two months. Here's how its speech recognizer hears, and what each size ships with.

scenes.label: The design
scenes.text: Each recognizer is a Whisper-style audio encoder bolted onto a small language model: merged audio frames replace placeholder tokens in the text.
scenes.say: Each recognizer is a Whisper-style audio encoder bolted onto a small language model. Merged audio frames drop in where placeholder tokens sit.

steps.say: Sound becomes a log-mel spectrogram, and a Whisper-style encoder turns it into a stream of frames.
An MLP adapter merges consecutive frames, four at a time in the smallest model.
Those embeddings replace dedicated audio placeholder tokens in the text sequence.
A Qwen-style causal decoder reads it all and writes the transcript.

right.title: GPA-v1.5: transcribes and speaks
items: Same encoder, adapter and layers, tensor for tensor
right.say: The other also speaks. Yet its encoder, adapter and decoder layers match the first, parameter for parameter.

scenes.title: How much each size name undercounts
scenes.note: a fixed 637M-parameter encoder is a shrinking share of a bigger decoder
scenes.say: That encoder is a fixed six hundred and thirty-seven million parameters, so every size name undercounts: the smallest by three point one three times, the largest by one point three five.

scenes.label: smaller decoder cache at INT4 than fp32, near the nominal 8x
scenes.say: Quantization pays close to its nominal rate. In the smallest model's ONNX bundle, four-bit shrinks the decoder cache seven point four five times.

items.say: The smallest recognizer gets the full ladder: three ONNX precisions, and a Core ML build for the iPhone.
The middle tier gets one precision each.
And the most downloaded model, the 3B recognizer, has no official export at all. Community conversions fill the gap.

scenes.text: One architecture serves every size, and even synthesis. The deployment work is richest where it is easiest: the small end.
scenes.say: One architecture serves every size, and even synthesis. The deployment work is richest where it is easiest: the small end.

recap: Whisper-style encoder, adapter, and a small decoder
The same parts run ASR and GPA-v1.5
Builds are rich at 0.1B, absent at 3B
scenes.say: To recap: an encoder, an adapter and a decoder, shared across jobs, with builds that thin out as the models grow.
